newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble steady ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Rouble steady ahead of weekend.

text.p: The rouble edged down during Friday trade but dealers said its decline was slower as banks were not eager to invest in dollars ahead of the weekend.
roubles/dollar Feb 21 midday Feb 21 early Feb 20 close
"The market is steady as usual. The dollar decline has slowed by Friday but it will resume the normal 2.5-3.0 points a day next week," United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said.
TOKObank dealer Stanislav Chernyakov said banks anticipated low rouble demand for Wednesday's Treasury bill auctions and preferred to open long rouble positions.
On Wednesday, February 26, the central bank is auctioning 7.5 trillion roubles of twelve-month paper and 4.5 trillion roubles of three-month bills.
Dealers said no impact was seen or likely on the rouble after the State Duma lower house of parliament called on Friday for limits on foreign investment in financial operations.

"The President is sure to stop the bill. If he does not it may cause an investment exodus from Russia. But no impact is likely on the rouble/dollar market anyway, it is and will be stable," Suchkov said.
